undertale_death_screen.config.shard_rend:
Configureth the style of the shattered heart pieces.
  Animateth: The piece shall animate but not rotate.
  Rotateth: The piece shall rotate but not animate.
undertale_death_screen.config.music_turn: Whether to cease all sound and minstrelsy upon thy demise.
undertale_death_screen.config.centered_h: Whether to center thy heart in the middle.
Whether to smoothly animate thy heart to the center before shattering.
Velocity of thy heart center animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.determinat: Whether to play minstrelsy (Determination) on thy death screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.dynamicHea:
Whether to dynamically alter thy heart texture based on thy status:
 - Poisoned
 - Withering
 - Freezing
undertale_death_screen.config.background:
The velocity at which to fill the screen with black.
If 0, it is disabled.
If 1, it is instantaneous.
undertale_death_screen.config.vanilla_fa: Whether the normal death screen dawns smoothly after shattering.
How long the dawning takes in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.text_fade_: Whether the 'You died' text fades in smoothly after the heart shatters.
How long the text fade in takes in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.fade_to_va: Whether the black background slowly fades to the vanilla death screen background.
Speed of fading back to the vanilla screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.fixed_anim: If true, the animation runs at a stable 60 FPS regardless of your framerate.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_bu: If true, you cannot click Respawn/Title Screen before the animation finishes.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_va: Disables the vanilla red tint around the edges of the screen after death animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.independen: If enabled, the death screen music will ignore the Music volume setting and only depend on the Master volume.
undertale_death_screen.config.preview_on: If ON, closing the config menu will instantly trigger a fake death screen to preview your settings.
